messages:
Hannah W.: Start thread for v0.9.6 docs changelog. Main tickets: #5401 (changelog draft), #5410 (sdk-snippet rename), #5417 (link fixes). Need a short "what changed" + 2 known issues.
Leonard S.: I can tidy the wording on the 'what changed' bullets. Keep each bullet single-sentence. Also: ensure we call out the python->responses rename.
Maya P.: On #5410 I updated the python and go snippets to `client.responses.create()` and `client.embeddings.create()` respectively. Left a one-line migration note above each sample.
Hannah W.: Great. Can you add a note about rate-limiting behavior changing for batched embeddings? One short sentence under known issues.
Maya P.: Done: "Batch embeddings may hit different rate limits vs streaming; consider smaller batches or backoff."
Leonard S.: For links: there are a couple of old absolute links to the beta console in docs. link-checker?
link-checker: Ran link-check on /docs; found 3 http->https issues and 2 broken anchors under /guides/serving. I opened #5417 with fixes.
Hannah W.: Nice. deploy-bot: what's the merge cutoff to make the release notes?
deploy-bot: Merge cutoff for docs_changelog queue is 07:00 PT. Any merges after that may roll to the next publish.
Leonard S.: I'll merge #5410 and #5417 now, then push my micro-copy edits to #5401.
Maya P.: Quick FYI: updated JS streaming example to recommend polling for long-running embedding jobs and linked to the migration guide.
Leonard S.: #5417 merged (redirects + anchors). #5410 merged (snippet rename). Pushing micro-edit to #5401.
Hannah W.: I'll review #5401 and merge if it's tidy. If CI flags anything, please hold on deploy.
link-checker: Post-merge run: no remaining broken links; two minor lint warnings.
Hannah W.: Merged #5401. Changelog queued for publish. If anything looks off after publish, post "docs-rollback" here and we'll revert the changelog PR. Thanks!
